incidents.short_description: Production database not responding - payment service down
incidents.description: Our payment processing service is unable to connect to the Oracle database. Customers are receiving 500 errors on checkout. Error in logs: ORA-12541: TNS: no listener. Started approximately 08:42 AM EST. Affecting all customers in the US region.

incidents.short_description: User authentication failing - LDAP timeout errors
incidents.description: Multiple users reporting they cannot log into the corporate portal. Authentication service is logging LDAP connection timeout errors every 30 seconds. Approximately 150 users affected based on helpdesk call volume. Error: javax.naming.CommunicationException: LDAP server unreachable.

incidents.short_description: Slow page load times on customer portal - 8-12 second delays
incidents.description: The customer-facing portal is loading significantly slower than normal. Pages that normally load in under 2 seconds are now taking 8-12 seconds. Dynatrace showing increased response times starting at 10:30 AM. No errors, just latency. Affects all browser types. About 400 active users.

incidents.short_description: Nightly ETL job failed - data pipeline error
incidents.description: The nightly ETL batch job that runs at 2 AM failed to complete. Error in logs: Connection pool exhausted after 300 seconds. Database queries running fine manually. Job has been working for 6 months, failed for the first time last night. Data warehouse may have stale data from yesterday.

incidents.short_description: API rate limit errors from third-party integration
incidents.description: Our integration with the shipping provider API is returning 429 Too Many Requests errors. Started hitting the rate limit around 2pm. We are currently processing 1200 requests/minute, the limit is 1000/min. Non-critical orders are being queued but there's a backlog building. Need to implement request throttling.

incidents.short_description: Report generation taking too long - finance dashboard timeout
incidents.description: Finance team reports that the monthly revenue report is timing out after 30 minutes. The same report ran in 4 minutes last month. No schema changes. Database has grown significantly - table now has 50M rows vs 12M last month. Query is doing a full table scan.

incidents.short_description: SSL certificate expiring in 3 days - renewal needed
incidents.description: The SSL certificate for api.internal.company.com expires on June 25, 2026. Automated renewal failed last week (ACME challenge failed). If not renewed, all API calls will start failing. This affects the mobile app and external partner integrations.

incidents.short_description: Single user cannot open attachments in ticketing system
incidents.description: User jdoe@company.com reports that clicking on attachments in the ticketing system gives a 403 Forbidden error. Other users can open the same attachments. Tried different browsers and computers. Issue started after password reset yesterday. User can still access all other features.

incidents.short_description: Memory leak in order-processing service - OOM restarts every 4 hours
incidents.description: The order-processing service is restarting every 3-4 hours due to OutOfMemoryError. Heap dumps show memory growing steadily from 2GB to 8GB before OOM. Issue started after last Tuesday's deployment (v2.4.1). Rolling restarts are masking the issue but causing brief disruptions. Needs root cause fix.

incidents.short_description: Disk usage at 94% on prod-db-01 - alert threshold exceeded
incidents.description: Disk usage on production database server prod-db-01 has reached 94%. Alert threshold is 90%. If it reaches 100%, the database will stop accepting writes. Main growth is in /var/lib/postgresql/data/pg_wal - WAL logs are not being cleaned up properly. Autovacuum may be disabled.
